verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers dashboards, charts, cohorts, and a Dashboard REST API, but contains no mention of subscribing to dashboards or receiving alerts when a metric moves abnormally (e.g., anomaly detection, alerting rules, or subscription/notification features). missing for 10: evidence of dashboard subscription feature, evidence of anomaly/alert detection on metrics, evidence of notification delivery (email/Slack) tied to metric changes.
